outcome: neonatal sepsis (early onset sepsis (EOS) and late onset sepsis (LOS))
cohort: The study included 111 neonates with a culture-proven diagnosis of neonatal sepsis from a COVID-19-tertiary care segregation hospital.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic year (2020), the incidence of early onset sepsis significantly increased, while late onset sepsis decreased, with no significant change in the overall neonatal sepsis mortality rate compared to 2019.
